newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: One killed, 50 injured in Bangladesh violence.
newsitem.headline: One killed, 50 injured in Bangladesh violence.

text.p: One man was killed and at least 50 people were injured in violence on Tuesday in Bangladesh's northern town of Gaffargaon before opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia addressed a rally, witnesses said.
They said unidentified activists attacked a train at Mashakhali station near Gaffargaon and a vehicle carrying reporters from the nearby town of Mymensigh to the rally.
The rally was organised by Khaleda's Bangladesh Nationalist Party.

Police said four reporters injured in stabbings and beatings were sent to Mymensingh hospital. The identity of the dead man was not known, police and journalists said. There were no immediate arrests.
Khaleda told the rally, held under heavy police guard, that she believed the attackers were supporters of the ruling Awami League.
"This is another proof of how repressive the government is. But I want to tell you that they can't hold on to power for long by using repression," local reporters quoted Khaleda as saying.
Khaleda left for Dhaka in the evening, they said.
